summary: 28-year-old man fell 30-40 feet down Cascade Falls into the creek, complaining of hip and back pain; GCSAR litter-evacuated him down steep terrain to Monarch Lake.
location: Cascade Falls above Monarch Lake, Grand County
notes: Notified 00:44 Sunday 2020-06-28. 15 GCSAR members + 2 MMT units; hasty team reached subject ~08:30; litter carry-out; all out of field 14:04. Subject non-ambulatory but no serious injuries; did not require ambulance transport. Subject and party from Fort Collins.
